text:
Your weekend does not
need more research.

Not the perfect event.
Not the optimal plan.

One thing, chosen by 6pm,
that gets you out the door.
The bar is low on purpose:
sub:
a coffee shop with your book *counts*.
A 45-minute event *counts*.

text:
Decide once. Go.
Let the night be ordinary.
